title: Exec staff meeting prep notes - 2026-03-20
content:
Purpose: prep notes for the weekly exec staff sync. Focus areas: key customer asks, SLOs/observability updates, Dedicated & Private pipeline status, runway/cost signals, and two escalations that need near-term decisions. Keep to 45 minutes.

Agenda (45 minutes)
- 0-5m: Quick pulse (Priya) — 30s per leader: top thing to flag this week
- 5-15m: Metrics snapshot + incidents (Daniel) — latency, throughput, cost trends, any ongoing incidents
- 15-25m: Customer & GTM highlights (Maria) — Dedicated commitments, major renewals, SAML/Compliance asks
- 25-35m: Product/roadmap asks (Samir) — Private deployment timelines, critical model onboarding blockers
- 35-45m: Decisions and action review (Priya) — confirm owners and due dates, escalate blockers

Key prep notes / talking points
1) Pulse (Priya)
- FYI: general sentiment = mixed. Hosting performance stable but we still see cost pressure on high-throughput customers. Need targeted recommendations from Optimize team by next week.
- Heads-up: board check-in in two weeks — want concise 3-slide update: 1) performance & SLOs, 2) customer traction (Dedicated/Private), 3) runway/cost action plan.

2) Metrics snapshot (Daniel)
- Latency: 95p token-response latency (hosted) = 118ms last week (down from 132ms two weeks ago).
- Throughput: aggregate tokens/sec up 12% week-over-week due to a large retailer test.
- Errors: user-facing error rate 0.35% (target <0.3%). Root cause: intermittent timeouts from KV cache invalidation during autoscale events. Incident INF-4783 opened.
- Cost: effective per-1M-token cost for top 10 customers up ~9% YoY due to GPU spot interruptions and fallback to on-demand. Need mitigation options: preemptible pools + better checkpointing.

Talking points for Daniel:
- Confirm incident status: INF-4783 assigned to SRE + serving-runtime — mitigation plan in place? Do we need to pause new Dedicated capacity adds until fix deployed?
- Ask: present 2 short options for cost mitigation this week (quick wins + medium term).

3) Customer & GTM (Maria)
- Sales pipeline: 3 Dedicated deals in late-stage (one >$500k ARR, two ~ $120k ARR each) — expected close in 30-60 days, contingent on SLA and PCI/KMS support.
- Private deployment interest: two regulated customers asking for VPC + HSM integration; legal reviewing statement of work. Implementation capacity limited in April.
- Churn signal: a mid-market customer indicated they might test other providers because of rising inference costs.

Talking points for Maria:
- Clarify resource prioritization: do we reallocate 1 FTE from Platform Eng to accelerate Private onboarding for one deal (short-term revenue impact)?
- Confirm timeline for providing a hardened KMS/HSM integration spec to PS by Fri (2026-03-27).

4) Product / Roadmap (Samir)
- Private: MVP for customer-managed control plane scoped for end of Q2. Current blockers: audit logging integration and automated rollback for canary deploys. Team needs a smaller rollback test harness.
- Models: onboarding 2 new community models with different attention patterns — runtime team needs to pick optimized kernels. Potential short-term latency regressions flagged.

Talking points for Samir:
- Ask for SRE + Runtime to prioritize automated rollback harness (estimate 2 wks). Is leadership OK to reassign 1 engineer from release engineering temporarily?
- Decision: approve temporary freeze on non-critical model onboardings until kernel tuning plan completed (target: 2026-03-31).

5) Escalations / Decisions needed
- Decision A (Immediate): Approve reallocation of one Platform Eng FTE to help deliver the KMS/HSM integration for Private deal A. Trade-off: minor delay to non-critical infra improvements. (Owner: Priya / Decision required by 2026-03-22)
- Decision B (Within 1 week): Approve temporary freeze on onboarding non-critical models until kernel tuning plan executed. (Owner: Samir / Decision required by 2026-03-27)

6) Risks to call out
- Runway: burn rate steady; however if top-tier customers push back on price or churn, guidance may shift. Prepare a 2-slide contingency (cost reduction levers and customer-facing communication) for board.
- Operational: autoscaling + KV cache invalidation causing both latency spikes and error rate; if unresolved, could impact new Dedicated customers signing SLAs.

Follow-up action items (explicit, owner, due)
1) Daniel: Draft incident postmortem (INF-4783) with timeline, root cause, and short-term mitigations. Due 2026-03-23.
2) Daniel + Runtime eng lead (Samir): Produce 2 cost-mitigation options (short-term & medium-term) for exec review. Due 2026-03-24.
3) Maria: Confirm Dedicated deal A legal SOW status and push for signature; update execs if any KMS/HSM redlines. Due 2026-03-25.
4) Priya: Prepare 3-slide board update (performance, customers, runway) draft for review. Due 2026-03-27.
5) Samir: Pause non-critical model onboardings and publish a kernel tuning plan with milestones through 2026-03-31. Due 2026-03-24.
6) Platform Eng manager (TBD): Evaluate feasibility of reallocating 1 FTE to Private onboarding and report impacts on roadmap. Due 2026-03-22.
7) Priya + Head of Sales (Maria): Draft customer communication template for customers affected by cost changes (tone: transparent, offering optimization help + pilot credits). Due 2026-03-26.

Notes to self / items to track after the meeting
- Compile a prioritized list of customers where we can apply Optimize quick wins (prefix caching, batching tweaks) and offer targeted assistance — target 5 customers by EOW.
- Confirm SRE timeline for a permanent fix to KV cache invalidation and whether we need to throttle Dedicated capacity signups until fix shipped.
- Capture any board feedback and coordinate with CFO on runway scenarios if churn risk materializes.

Meeting logistics and prep reminders
- Bring the incident timeline (Daniel) and the cost mitigation slide (Daniel + Samir) to the meeting in slide form (1 slide each).
- Maria to bring a one-line summary of each late-stage deal with ask (SLA/KMS items).
- Samir to bring a short written proposal for gating model onboardings (1 paragraph + checklist).

If time remains in the meeting: quick round-robin on org health (hiring, ramp, notable wins) — keep to 5 minutes.

End of notes.
summary_notes: Exec weekly prep for 45min meeting. Main asks: incident postmortem (INF-4783), cost mitigation options, decision on reallocating 1 FTE for Private onboarding, temporary freeze on non-critical model onboardings. Owners and due dates listed.
